name: Godlessness
overview: Scripture reveals that godlessness is marked by a rejection and forgetting of God, leading to spiritual decline and destruction. Deuteronomy highlights God's just recompense toward those who hate Him, while the Israelites' forsaking of their Maker resulted in arrogance and loss of salvation's foundation. Job illustrates the fragile and fleeting nature of those who forget God, comparing their paths to withered plants, and laments the absence of recognition for God as Creator and source of comfort. Together, these verses underscore the peril and judgment inherent in turning away from God.
